application.observed: Source bytes preserved; reviewed dependency lock; one emitted root with native binding and one hosted Write-Output site; generated executable launched through compiled factory; original/generated exit code, stderr and all 21 stdout lines matched.

design: Shared Hybrid entry planner attempts the existing scalar route first, then bounded native script-root lowering for an explicit win-x64/net10 target.
Build and explain use the same final planner. The build analysis plan receives the resolved artifact target contract.

Native admission excludes authored declarations, named lifecycle clauses, requirements, dot-source closure, caller-frame variables, metadata commands, parent runtime/module state and provider cancellation. Hosted body commands are limited to ordinary, nonredirected Write-Output sites.

Native artifact stores exact authored decoded text as Source.ps1 and emits a source-hashed factory. The generated launcher invokes its ExternalScriptInfo through ordinary PowerShell call-operator dispatch.
Unsupported entries retain the existing scalar route or authored hosted source. Package launcher keeps its original AddScript path; Strict remains unchanged.
initialFailures: First artifact test: explain emitted but build retained the root because builder analysis did not carry the resolved target contract. Shared plan construction now carries it; the corrected focused artifact run passed.

The first test compilation attempted to set a nonexistent PowerShellCompilationSpec.TargetContract property. The test now uses the analyzer overload with the explicit target; this was test setup, not product behavior.
limits: First native artifact route only: explicit Windows x64/net10 Hybrid target; no net472 executable or non-Windows artifact execution claim.
Only one end-only authored script source; top-level functions/types, using, requirements, script dependencies and named lifecycle owners remain hosted.
Only the observed Write-Output command family is admitted as a hosted command region; other command resolution, redirection and dynamic invocation stay on scalar or hosted fallback.
Caller-frame observations and full return/exit/stream/stopping/cleanup, resource/dependency ordering and wider system policy need separate qualification.

One external standalone workflow and one synthetic binding/error workflow are qualified; no module-method inventory gain. 544/565 emitted functions, 21 retained, fifteen justified hosted, six WPF unqualified.
No 40-minute aggregate gate or module census, PR, merge or release.
